comment: D3 confirmation-pattern acknowledgments (Compass Phase 5 eval P0-2). One line shown above the confession when the player responds to the Bard's reading — so 'the record, working' visibly registers. Keyed by the D3 choice id.

acks.correct: Struck. Your reading replaces mine in the file, in your hand. — The record, working.
acks.complicate: Filed as: more tangled than that. The tangle is kept, uncondensed. — The record, working.
acks.accept: Entered as read. The Bard takes no pleasure in being right; it only, at last, stops asking. — The record holds.
acks.refuse_classification: The field is left open. The Bard has learned, slowly, to prefer it that way. — The record, unfinished, and working.
